# Eco Sure Testing LLC

> Eco Sure Testing LLC is an independent mold testing and inspection company serving Los Angeles County and San Diego County, California. We perform testing and lab-certified reporting only — we never perform mold remediation — so our findings carry no conflict of interest. Phone: (747) 254-8454. Hours: Sunday–Friday 7am–7pm, closed Saturday.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ecosuretesting.com/): Overview of independent mold testing services in Los Angeles and San Diego.
- [Services](https://ecosuretesting.com/services.html): Air quality (spore) testing, surface sampling, moisture detection, visual inspection, post-remediation clearance, and real estate/pre-purchase testing.
- [Mold Testing Los Angeles](https://ecosuretesting.com/mold-testing-los-angeles.html): Mold testing coverage and information for Los Angeles County.
- [Mold Testing San Diego](https://ecosuretesting.com/mold-testing-san-diego.html): Mold testing coverage and information for San Diego County.
- [Independent Mold Testing](https://ecosuretesting.com/independent-mold-testing-los-angeles.html): Why third-party, conflict-free mold testing matters and how to read a mold report.
- [Post-Remediation Clearance Testing](https://ecosuretesting.com/post-remediation-clearance-testing.html): Independent verification that a completed mold remediation actually worked.
- [About](https://ecosuretesting.com/about.html): Company background and values.
- [FAQ](https://ecosuretesting.com/faq.html): Common questions about cost, process, and independence.
- [Contact](https://ecosuretesting.com/contact.html): Request a free mold testing quote.
